newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Leaders of Nigeria and Niger hold talks.
newsitem.headline: Leaders of Nigeria and Niger hold talks.

text.p: Talks opened on Saturday in Nigeria's capital Abuja between military ruler General Sani Abacha and President Ibrahim Bare Mainassara of neighbouring Niger, officials said.
"It is their first summit of the year to review matters of mutual interest to our two brotherly nations," said a presidency official, who declined to go into specific issues on the agenda.
Mainassara arrived in Abuja on Friday for a two day visit.
A regular visitor to the Nigerian capital, the Niger president was welcomed at Abuja airport by Abacha.
According to Niger radio, Mainassara will go from Abuja to Cotonou in Benin, and Ouagadougou in Burkina Faso for talks with presidents Mathieu Kerekou and Blaise Compaore, respectively.
